# Model Fitting Setup Validation

Make the estimand and fitted data explicit before comparing or accepting
models.

## Setup

Resolve the applicable choices:

- requested output: prediction, optimum location, response at the optimum,
  model metric, coefficient, p-value, class, or another quantity;
- response and predictor definitions, units, transformations, and category or
  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;
- candidate models, formulas, fixed parameters, and fitting implementation;
- comparison metric and convention

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript -e '
d <- read.csv(\"inputs/Swarm_2.csv\", check.names=FALSE)
d <- subset(d, StrainNumber %in% c(\"98\", \"287\", \"287_98\"))
d"'$frequency <- ifelse(d$StrainNumber == "98", 0, ifelse(d$StrainNumber == "287", 1, vapply(strsplit(d$Ratio, ":", fixed=TRUE), function(z) as.numeric(z[1])/sum(as.numeric(z)), numeric(1))))
library(splines)
mods <- list(quadratic=lm(Area ~ frequency + I(frequency''^2), d), cubic=lm(Area ~ frequency + I(frequency''^2) + I(frequency''^3), d), natural_spline_df4=lm(Area ~ ns(frequency, df=4), d))
print(data.frame(model=names(mods), n=vapply(mods,nobs,numeric(1)), k=vapply(mods,function(m) length(coef(m)),numeric(1)), AIC=vapply(mods,AIC,numeric(1)), BIC=vapply(mods,BIC,numeric(1)), R2=vapply(mods,function(m) summary(m)$r.squared,numeric(1)), adjR2=vapply(mods,function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared,numeric(1)), RMSE=vapply(mods,function(m) sqrt(mean(resid(m)''^2)),numeric(1))))
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  m <- mods[[nm]]
  oo <- optimize(function(x) -predict(m, newdata=data.frame(frequency=x)), interval=c(0,1), tol=.Machine$double.eps''^0.25)
  cat("'"\\n\", nm, \" optimum_frequency=\", format(oo"'$minimum, digits=17), " predicted_max=", format(-oo$objective, digits=17), "'"\\n\", sep=\"\")
  print(coef(m), digits=17)
}
'"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript -e '
d <- read.csv(\"inputs/Swarm_2.csv\", check.names=FALSE)
d <- subset(d, StrainNumber %in% c(\"98\", \"287\", \"287_98\"))
d"'$frequency <- ifelse(d$StrainNumber == "98", 0, ifelse(d$StrainNumber == "287", 1, vapply(strsplit(d$Ratio, ":", fixed=TRUE), function(z) as.numeric(z[1])/sum(as.numeric(z)), numeric(1))))
library(splines)
m <- lm(Area ~ ns(frequency, df=4), data=d)
g <- seq(0, 1, length.out=100001)
y <- predict(m, newdata=data.frame(frequency=g))
i <- which.max(y)
br <- c(g[max(1,i-2)], g[min(length(g),i+2)])
o <- optimize(function(x) -as.numeric(predict(m, newdata=data.frame(frequency=x))), interval=br, tol=.Machine$double.eps)
stopifnot(nobs(m) == 42, o$minimum > 0, o$minimum < 1, -o$objective >= max(c(predict(m, data.frame(frequency=0)), predict(m, data.frame(frequency=1)))))
cat(sprintf("frequency=%.12f'"\\nmaximum=%.12f\\ngrid_max=%.12f\\n\", o"'$minimum, -o$objective, max(y)))
'"'"
